description: Uploads an image or video to Auto Poster media library. Accepts files generated in ChatGPT (e.g. DALL-E images in /mnt/data/), uploaded files, or public image URLs. Direct chat download limit is 100MB. For larger videos or files (>100MB), tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposter_get_media_upload_url for direct S3 upload up to 5GB. If the image exists only in the chat or on the user's device and cannot be sent here, use autoposter_create_upload_link instead.

file.description: File object provided by ChatGPT for AI-generated images or uploaded files.

name.description: Optional display name or title for the media file.

url.description: Optional public image or video URL or data URI to upload into media library.

name: autoposter_upload_media

mediaId.description: ID of the newly uploaded media item.

mediaUrl.description: Public URL of the media file to pass in posts.

url.description: Public URL of the media file.

usage.description: Guidance on using the media item in posts.

title: Upload Media File
